headline: Restrictive and leaning tighter: futures price about 94% odds of +25 bp on Dec 9 (roughly 6% for 50 bp), and the dollar holds a 19-month high near 103.9, while the 10-year stays just above 5% and the 10s-2s curve sits near +28 bp. Oil is flat near $83 WTI after a crude build, and HY spreads near 343 bp still lean wider. Underwrite floating-rate debt 25–50 bp higher after December, keep the 10-year above 5% in hurdle rates, and lock fixed-rate financing on dips while credit windows stay open.
